plan_needed: A Karbon Business or Enterprise plan (Team has no API access). Firms are limited to one API application per account. Someone with access to Karbon Settings; the help article doesn't say which role. Programming skills to use the credentials. Karbon also lists an MCP server address (https://mcp.karbonhq.com) but publishes no steps for it, so it isn't covered here.

steps.do: Go to Settings. Under Integrations and Tools, select API Applications.
Select the API Applications tab, then click Enable API Access.
steps.see: The page refreshes and your API application appears in the list, named after your practice.

steps.do: Click Manage next to your application.
steps.see: The API Authentication screen, showing an Application ID (used as the bearer token) and an Access Key (a JWT token).

steps.do: Click Copy for each value and store them in an environment variable or a secrets manager. Treat them like passwords, and never paste them into a chat or a website.
steps.see: Your app can now call the Karbon REST API, within its limit of 120 requests a minute.

undo.where: Karbon, Settings > Integrations and Tools > API Applications
undo.do: Click Manage next to your application, then Rotate next to the Access Key, and confirm with Rotate.
undo.see: The old Access Key stops working immediately, along with anything still using it. The docs we read don't describe turning API access off entirely.
